entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I'm a bit overwhelmed. I bought these cycling shoes and I... I think I need to send them back. The website was very confusing.

I can certainly help you look into a return. I'm sorry to hear the website was confusing. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I'm not sure what the difference is. I attached the cleats and went for one ride, and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't feel right at all. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Oh, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm very sorry about that. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay, I see your order for the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 27 days ago. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on items like these within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a huge relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. I've just initiated that return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. I also see that you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the trouble with the blisters, I've added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, a credit as well? That is so nice of you. You've made this so easy. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
